metadata.name: Sunstone Crag
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A giant stepped pyramid in the desert, the king-of-the-hill mountain at the heart of the map. Fight up seven sandstone tiers by the zigzag stairs, the face jump pads or the sand drifts at two corners to the summit and its beacon, or go inside: four tunnels lead to the catacombs round the tomb, where a crumbling walkway crosses the lava pit to double damage, and the treasure vault on the third tier holds the railgun. Embers and Tide camp at either end of an avenue of obelisks with buggies and gun jeeps; between them lie dunes, ruined temples, two palm oases and sand traps that give way under your feet.
